device.description: 12-bit 20 MSPS pipelined ADC with internal reference, over-range output and tri-state CMOS parallel outputs (3 V / 5 V output driver supply)
device.note: ads805.pdf (SBAS073B) p.3 specifications (digital inputs/outputs, straight offset binary, 3-state enable 40 ns / disable 10 ns max, +VS 4.75-5.25 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12 ns max, 6-clock latency), application section: OVR over-range output (same latency as data), VDRV output driver supply for 3 V or 5 V logic

pages: p.3 (specs), p.4 (pinout, pin descriptions, timing: t2 12 ns), application section (OVR, VDRV, reference/SEL)
notModeled: analog input, reference and input-range selection (SEL / VREF straps are analog connections); the result is always the 0 V differential (mid-scale) code 800h, straight offset binary
OVR is driven as the first bit of each 13-bit data word (always 0: the 0 V input is in range); whether OE also floats OVR is not stated
pipeline latency of 6 clock cycles (the code is constant)
clock period / duty-cycle limits (50 ns to 100 us)

two supplies: +VS 4.75-5.25 V (analog core, CLK/OE input thresholds VIH 3.5 V) and VDRV (output drivers, 3 V or 5 V logic); vcc is the union 3.0-5.25 V and +VS is listed under analog so VDRV is the digital supply
3-state enable time (40 ns max) differs from the disable time (10 ns); tFloat uses the disable time
pin 23 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar in the datasheet); both inputs are named IN
variants: ADS804 (5 MSPS) and ADS805 (20 MSPS) share this pinout and interface (separate datasheets, own specs)
